meta.description: Use this skill for MolMIM, NVIDIA's BioNeMo NIM microservice for small-molecule latent-space generation and optimization. Invoke for MolMIM, molecular embeddings, hidden states, latent decoding, sampling around a seed SMILES, CMA-ES guided molecule generation, QED or plogP optimization, hosted NVIDIA API calls, or local Docker deployment.

recommendations.title: Clarify min_similarity range recommendation
recommendations.problem: Gotchas mention 0-1 range in hosted API reference but emphasize up to 0.7 in local docs without clear guidance on which to follow
recommendations.root_cause: API spec vs practical usage documentation conflict not resolved
recommendations.fix: Update gotchas: 'min_similarity: 0-1 is the API-accepted range; values >0.7 may over-constrain optimization and yield few results. Start with 0.4-0.6 for balanced exploration; increase toward 0.7 for tighter similarity constraints.'

recommendations.title: Add handling for empty generation results
recommendations.problem: molmim_smiles helper raises RuntimeError on empty results but no guidance on recovery or parameter adjustment
recommendations.root_cause: Assumes generation always produces molecules; constraint satisfaction failures not addressed
recommendations.fix: Add to Troubleshooting: 'Empty generation results → constraints too tight (min_similarity too high, iterations too low, or seed SMILES in low-density latent region). Try: reduce min_similarity by 0.1-0.2, increase iterations, or increase particles for broader exploration.'

recommendations.title: Add inline explanation for molmim_smiles helper
recommendations.problem: molmim_smiles function handles complex response format variations but logic not explained inline
recommendations.root_cause: Helper function optimized for robustness without documentation
recommendations.fix: Add comment before molmim_smiles definition: '# Robust parser handling API format variations: generated (list of strings or nested lists) and molecules (JSON string of {sample, score} objects). Returns flat list of SMILES strings.'

recommendations.title: Add idempotency statement for generation
recommendations.problem: No explicit guidance on whether running generation with same seed and parameters produces identical results
recommendations.fix: Add to generation gotchas: 'Generation is stochastic: same seed SMILES and parameters will produce different molecules across runs (CMA-ES exploration is non-deterministic). For reproducible molecule libraries, save and version generated outputs rather than regenerating.'
